title: 第13章 赚取宗门贡献值第14章 剿匪小队
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 姚德龙面色如常，仿佛那些恶毒的话语只是拂过耳边的微风。
他浑浊的眼睛平静无波，径直穿过人群，对那些指指点点的目光视而不见。
径直走向大殿中央那块巨大的、不断滚动着信息的任务光幕。
他可是清楚，在这多说也无益，得靠实力才能堵住这些人的嘴！
目光飞快扫过一个个任务：
“灵兽峰清点饲养碧眼蟾蜍卵，需细心耐心，奖励：5贡献点。”
“灵植峰十亩火灵稻除草除虫，限时三日，奖励：4贡献点。”
“器堂地火室值守，需耐高温火气，奖励：8贡献点日。”
都是些繁琐、耗时、奖励微薄的杂役任务。
姚德龙的目光继续下移，最终，定格在光幕右下角一个并不起眼的任务上：
【任务：清剿山外荒土村马匪】
【地点：阴阳宗外三百里，荒土村】
【要求：凝气五层以上修为，五人小队，擅长搏杀者优先】
【详情：一伙约二十人的凶悍马匪盘踞荒土村周边，劫掠商队，残害村民，
疑似有低阶修士混迹其中（推测最高凝气八层）。
请速往清剿，还地方安宁。
【奖励：50贡献点人，清剿成功小队成员可额外获得一次玄兵阁——灵器（极品灵器以下）自选机会。
“50贡献点！
还有一次选极品灵器以下的机会？”
姚德龙心中一动。
贡献点在宗门内比灵石更硬通，
可以兑换灵石、丹药、功法乃至进入某些秘境的资格！
而那一次玄兵阁自选机会更是诱人！
他现在虽然有钱，但动动手就能得到机会还是更香！
最关键的是，曾经作为“废柴”
的他，
只敢龟缩在宗门最安全的角落，靠着写话本消磨时光。
如今修为提升，也是应该赚取点贡献值，以便后续换取功法！
老是在屋里炼丹，也是枯燥难耐。
“就它了！”
姚德龙不再犹豫，直接走到光幕旁的任务接取处。
手指在那条任务信息上一点，一道微光闪过，信息旁边出现了他的名字。
负责登记的是一个看起来颇为伶俐的年轻女弟子。
她看着光幕上显示的接取人“姚德龙（落霞峰）”
又抬头看看眼前这个气息微弱、行将就木的老者，小嘴微张，脸上写满了惊愕和为难。
“这位……这位师叔！”
她声音有些结巴，
“这个任务是团队任务……需要五人组队才能接取的。
目前……目前只有您和另一位柳如媚师姐接取了，还……还差三人。
您看……是不是先回去等通知？
等凑齐了人，宗门会通过灵鸽传信通知您集合时间和地点。”
content_en:
Yao Delong's expression remained as usual, as if those vicious words were just the breeze blowing by his ears.
His cloudy eyes were calm and he walked straight through the crowd, ignoring the pointing eyes.
Go straight to the huge mission light curtain in the center of the hall, which is constantly scrolling with information.
But he knows that there is no use in talking more here. You have to rely on strength to stop these people's mouths!
His eyes quickly scanned each task:
"Spirit Beast Peak counts and raises blue-eyed toad eggs. Care and patience are required. Reward: 5 contribution points."
"Ten acres of fire rice in Lingzhi Peak will be used to eliminate weeds and insects. The time limit is three days. Reward: 4 contribution points."
"On duty in the underground fire room of the Qi Hall, you need to be able to withstand high-temperature fire and gas. Reward: 8 contribution points per day."
…
They are all tedious, time-consuming and poorly rewarded chores.
Yao Delong's eyes continued to move downward, and finally, they settled on an inconspicuous task in the lower right corner of the light screen:
[Mission: Clear out the horse bandits in the wasteland village outside the mountain]
[Location: Three hundred miles outside the Yin Yang Sect, Wasteland Village]
[Requirements: Qi Condensation level five or above, five-person team, priority will be given to those who are good at fighting]
[Details: A group of about 20 fierce horse bandits are entrenched around the wasteland village, plundering caravans and killing villagers.
It is suspected that there are low-level monks among them (presumably the highest level is the eighth level of Qi Condensation).
Please go clear it out quickly and restore peace to the place.
[Reward: 50 contribution points. Members of the successful team will receive an additional opportunity to choose Xuanbing Pavilion - a spiritual weapon (below the best spiritual weapon).
"50 contribution points!
Is there another chance to choose a top-notch spiritual weapon? "
Yao Delong's heart moved.
Contribution points are more difficult to pass through within the sect than spirit stones.
You can redeem spiritual stones, elixirs, exercises and even the qualifications to enter certain secret realms!
And that opportunity for self-selection in Xuanbing Pavilion was even more tempting!
Although he has money now, it would be better if he can get an opportunity with his hands!
The most important thing is that once as a "waste"
of him,
He only dared to huddle in the safest corner of the sect and pass the time by writing a storybook.
Now that your cultivation level has improved, you should also earn some contribution points so that you can exchange for skills later!
Refining elixirs in the house all the time is boring.
"That's it!"
Yao Delong no longer hesitated and walked directly to the task reception area next to the light curtain.
Pointing his finger on the mission message, a faint light flashed and his name appeared next to the message.
The person in charge of registration was a young female disciple who looked quite smart.
She looked at the recipient "Yao Delong (Luoxia Peak)" displayed on the light screen.
Then he looked up at the dying old man with weak breath in front of him. His mouth was slightly open, and his face was full of surprise and embarrassment.
"This...this uncle!"
Her voice stuttered a little,
"This mission is a team mission...it requires a team of five people to take it on.
Currently...only you and another senior sister Liu Rumei have taken it, and there are still...three people to go.
You see...should we go back and wait for notification?
Once everyone is gathered, the sect will notify you of the gathering time and location via a spirit pigeon message. "
title_en: Chapter 13 Earning Sect Contribution Points Chapter 14 Bandit Suppression Team
